summary: The catalogue API answers the same questions as the storefront
description: The storefront is one client of a public REST API that other people integrate against. The two have to agree, and the API has to keep the shape it publishes.
acceptanceCriteria: The products endpoint returns a page of products with a total count.
Searching the API for a term returns the same products the storefront shows for it.
Every product in the catalogue has a name and a price.
The categories endpoint lists the categories the storefront filters by.
